name: Anima post-CFG utilities
plain: Three small post-CFG tools sharing one sigma-progress window. A frequency scale with a square low-pass box, a channel mean remover, and a noise add that rises and falls across the window. Names suggest model tuning; the code has no Anima-specific logic.
math:
Freq: F(x̂)·mask, mask=low inside a box of half-size cutoff, high outside; scales ramp from 1 across the window.
Mean: x̂−=mean_channel(x̂)·k.
Sculpt: x̂+=n·k·sin(π t), t in the window. Note n is added to the denoised prediction, not to the latent.
Rescale: x̂=m·x̂·std(c)/std(x̂)+(1−m)x̂ on denoised, not v.
label: from code
